description: This file defines an interface for handling IPv4 and IPv6 address functionalities, including conversion, comparison, and interface address operations within a network-related project.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_family
methods.description: Retrieves the address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6) of the provided ipaddr_t address.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_to_inaddr
methods.description: Converts nu_ipaddr_t to a standard in_addr structure, if applicable.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_to_in6addr
methods.description: Converts nu_ipaddr_t to a standard in6_addr structure, if applicable.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_to_sockaddr
methods.description: Converts nu_ipaddr_t to a generic sockaddr_storage with specified port.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_to_str
methods.description: Converts nu_ipaddr_t to its string representation.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of nu_ipaddr_t, possibly using provided buffer.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_from_str
methods.description: Parses a string to fill a nu_ipaddr_t structure.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_from_sockaddr_storage
methods.description: Extracts nu_ipaddr_t and port from a sockaddr_storage structure.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_from_inaddr
methods.description: Initializes nu_ipaddr_t from an in_addr structure.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_from_in6addr
methods.description: Initializes nu_ipaddr_t from an in6_addr structure.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_equal
methods.description: Compares two nu_ipaddr_t addresses for equality.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_copy
methods.description: Copies one nu_ipaddr_t address to another.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_set_zero
methods.description: Sets a nu_ipaddr_t address to zero.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_is_zero
methods.description: Checks if a nu_ipaddr_t address is zero.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_interface_addr_from_dest_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the interface address associated with a destination address.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_interface_addr_from_sock_fd
methods.description: Gets the interface address from a socket file descriptor.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_interface_name_from_src_addr
methods.description: Gets the interface name associated with a source address.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_has_interface_addr_changed
methods.description: Checks if the interface address has changed for a given device.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_get_ip_supported_families
methods.description: Determines if IPv4 and/or IPv6 are supported.

methods.name: nu_ipaddr_is_valid_interface
methods.description: Validates if a network interface is valid.

methods.name: tw_ulib_diags_family_to_protocol_version
methods.description: Converts address family to protocol version string.

methods.name: tw_ulib_diags_lookup_host
methods.description: Resolves a hostname to its IP address, with preference options.

methods.name: tw_ulib_get_dev_ipaddr
methods.description: Gets device IP address for a specified interface.
